consider_separating: AHA/BHA at the same step on sensitive skin

watchouts.what_to_do: Start 2x/week at low strength and build up; buffer with moisturizer. Avoid stacking with strong acids at the same step.
Use PM only with daily SPF; retinoids are generally advised against in pregnancy — consult a professional.

benefits.mechanism: Retinol converts in skin to retinoic acid, which binds retinoic-acid receptors, up-regulating procollagen synthesis and down-regulating the matrix-metalloproteinases that break collagen down; tretinoin (the prescription retinoid) restored collagen formation in photodamaged skin on biopsy (Griffiths/Voorhees, NEJM 1993).
benefits.what_it_means: Softens the look of fine lines and improves firmness over 12 weeks of consistent use.

benefits.mechanism: Retinoids normalise keratinocyte differentiation and accelerate epidermal turnover, refining surface texture.
benefits.what_it_means: Smooths rough texture and boosts radiance by renewing the surface.

benefits.mechanism: Faster, more even turnover disperses surface pigment and evens the stratum corneum.
benefits.what_it_means: Fades the look of uneven tone and post-blemish marks over time.

evidence.summary: The retinoid receptor mechanism (collagen up, MMP down) is well established; tretinoin RCTs show biopsy-confirmed collagen restoration. Retinol is the cosmetic precursor that converts to the same active, at gentler potency; graded B for the cosmetic form.

citations.title: Restoration of collagen formation in photodamaged human skin by tretinoin (retinoic acid)
citations.source: New England Journal of Medicine (Griffiths et al.)

citations.title: Topical tretinoin for treating photoaging: a systematic review of randomized controlled trials

overview: Retinol is the best-evidenced anti-aging active class for smoothing fine lines and improving firmness, working by signalling collagen synthesis and normalising skin-cell turnover; results build gradually over 8-12+ weeks.

ingredient.what_it_is: The cosmetic form of vitamin A. In skin it is converted to retinoic acid, the active retinoid that signals skin cells to renew and build collagen.

marketing_vs_reality.reality: Retinol is converted to its active form in two steps, so visible change is gradual — texture in weeks, firmness and fine lines over 12 weeks or more. Higher strength is not always better; tolerance builds slowly.
